name: empty-container
title: Empty a container
description: Take every object out of a container and put it on/into a destination receptacle.
use_when: A container must be emptied into another container or onto a surface.

not_to_be_confused_with.pour: empty may also pick items out one by one.

receptacle.description: Where the contents go (a container for the pouring path).

preconditions.name: hand_empty
preconditions.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

preconditions.name: uncovered
preconditions.meaning: No lid rests on the container rim.
preconditions.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

postconditions.name: container_empty
postconditions.meaning: No annotated object is inside the container.
postconditions.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

verifier.how: after the policy chain, every listed predicate is evaluated on ground-truth simulator state (object poses, joint values, finger gaps, head-camera geometry, thermal state, event log); the node succeeds only if all hold for the selected path

checks.name: container_empty
checks.meaning: No annotated object is inside the container.
checks.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

chain: for each item in @container.contents: policy_092($container) -> policy_061($item) -> [navigate](destination=$receptacle) -> [place](object=$item, receptacle=$receptacle)
policy_paths.note: Take the items out one by one. (Pouring loose solids needs the cup past ~90 deg, which the arm cannot reach over the stove; the pour path is kept as an alternative.)
A cup or mug of loose items is emptied by pouring, then put back.

previous.when: every object inside must be removed

fallback.when: the container has its lid on

alternative.when: the items lie on a surface instead

failure.on_failure: stop; return every measured predicate, the completed policy steps and the fallback skills whose repaired predicate failed; the planner chooses what to do. Inside a multi-object node a nested call that fails a precondition with a matching repair fallback runs that repair once and retries.
